claim_boundary: deterministic candidate posture findings only; not launch approval, exploitability analysis, proof of security, or compliance certification

findings.claim_limit: File contents and distribution-specific policy were not assessed.
findings.recommendation: Review ownership and permissions before changing them; preserve service-specific exceptions.
findings.title: Critical account or privilege file metadata fell outside the admitted baseline

findings.claim_limit: This does not prove that root login was used or externally reachable.
findings.recommendation: Disable direct root SSH login and use attributable privilege elevation.
findings.title: SSH effective configuration permits direct root login

findings.claim_limit: Account names and authentication activity were not collected.
findings.recommendation: Review whether every UID 0 account is required and separately attributable.
findings.title: More than one UID 0 account was observed

findings.claim_limit: A failed unit is not by itself evidence of compromise or business impact.
findings.recommendation: Review each failed unit against the host's intended service inventory.
findings.title: Failed system services were observed

findings.claim_limit: Upstream firewalls and actual reachability were not tested.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the intended network-control boundary and enable a host firewall where required.
findings.title: Host firewall was observed inactive

findings.claim_limit: This does not prove weak passwords, exposure, or successful authentication.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate disabling password authentication after confirming an approved key-based recovery path.
findings.title: SSH password authentication is enabled

findings.claim_limit: The collector did not compare the clock against an independent time authority.
findings.recommendation: Restore approved time synchronization and record the source used.
findings.title: Host clock reported not synchronized

findings.claim_limit: This is a posture observation, not proof that workload isolation is ineffective.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the host's intended mandatory-access-control policy and platform support.
findings.title: No enforcing AppArmor or SELinux state was observed
